mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(S.COURSE_DATE), 'YYYYMMDD') AS DATE_KEY, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(S.COURSE_DATE), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS COURSE_DATE, TO_CHAR(P.PLAN_NO) AS PLAN_NO, P.COURSE_NAME_CODE, TO_CHAR(P.PERIOD_TIME) AS PERIOD_TIME, TO_CHAR(MIN(S.COURSE_START_DATE), 'HH24:MI') AS START_TIME, TO_CHAR(MAX(S.COURSE_END_DATE), 'HH24:MI') AS END_TIME FROM EDU_TRAIN_SYLLABUS S, EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P WHERE S.PLAN_NO = P.PLAN_NO AND S.ACTIVITY = 1 AND P.ACTIVITY <> 0 AND S.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND S.COURSE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{yearMonth, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '01', 'YYYYMMDD') AND S.COURSE_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{yearMonth, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 1) GROUP BY TRUNC(S.COURSE_DATE), P.PLAN_NO, P.COURSE_NAME_CODE, P.PERIOD_TIME ORDER BY TRUNC(S.COURSE_DATE), MIN(S.COURSE_START_DATE), P.COURSE_NAME_CODE
